SELECT
    events.event AS event,
    has(events.properties_group_custom, %(hogql_val_0)s) ? events.properties_group_custom[%(hogql_val_0)s] : null AS path,
    has(events.properties_group_custom, %(hogql_val_1)s) ? events.properties_group_custom[%(hogql_val_1)s] : null AS slot,
    count() AS events,
    count(DISTINCT if(not(empty(events__override.distinct_id)), events__override.person_id, events.person_id)) AS persons
FROM
    events
    LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT
        tupleElement(argMax(tuple(person_distinct_id_overrides.person_id), person_distinct_id_overrides.version), 1) AS person_id,
        person_distinct_id_overrides.distinct_id AS distinct_id
    FROM
        person_distinct_id_overrides
    WHERE
        equals(person_distinct_id_overrides.team_id, 451906)
    GROUP BY
        person_distinct_id_overrides.distinct_id
    HAVING
        ifNull(equals(tupleElement(argMax(tuple(person_distinct_id_overrides.is_deleted), person_distinct_id_overrides.version), 1), 0), 0)
    SETTINGS optimize_aggregation_in_order=1) AS events__override ON equals(events.distinct_id, events__override.distinct_id)
WHERE
    and(equals(events.team_id, 451906), greaterOrEquals(events.timestamp, minus(now64(6, %(hogql_val_2)s), toIntervalDay(7))), equals(events.event, %(hogql_val_3)s))
GROUP BY
    events.event,
    path,
    slot
ORDER BY
    events DESC
LIMIT 200 SETTINGS readonly=2, max_execution_time=10, max_threads=60, allow_experimental_object_type=1, max_ast_elements=4000000, max_expanded_ast_elements=4000000, max_bytes_before_external_group_by=0, transform_null_in=1, optimize_min_equality_disjunction_chain_length=4294967295, allow_experimental_join_condition=1, use_hive_partitioning=0

SELECT
    event,
    properties.path AS path,
    properties.slot AS slot,
    count() AS events,
    count(DISTINCT person_id) AS persons
FROM
    events
WHERE
    and(greaterOrEquals(timestamp, minus(now(), toIntervalDay(7))), equals(event, 'ad_click'))
GROUP BY
    event,
    path,
    slot
ORDER BY
    events DESC
LIMIT 200
